verdict.rationale: Babylon.js docs claim built-in physics via Havok/Cannon.js/Ammo.js integration plus ray casting and mesh picking support, suggesting out-of-the-box physics, but a detailed hands-on community critique specifically calls the physics implementation 'inexcusably incompetent,' citing concrete bugs like treating velocity and acceleration as the same dimension and lacking proper world-time handling. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or third-party validation refuting the critique, first-party docs addressing collision/raycast accuracy specifically, and more recent community confirmation the flagged bugs were fixed.
